title: Verify anonymous to authenticated migration flow
description: End-to-end verification that anonymous progress stored in localStorage correctly migrates to Convex when user signs up with 'Bring my progress' checked.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Anonymous user can practice song and mark words/lines learned
Progress visible on song page as green checkmarks
User signs up with 'Bring my progress' checkbox checked
After magic link verification, user redirected to dashboard
Song page shows same checkmarks as before signup
localStorage is cleared after successful migration
User can continue practicing and progress saves to Convex

technicalNotes: Use tempmail MCP for signup testing:
- Fill signup form with temp email
- get_messages: Check inbox for magic link
- Extract and navigate to magic link URL
Use browser console to verify localStorage state before/after
Check Convex dashboard to verify records created
testingNotes: Practice on at least 2 different songs
Mark at least 5 words and 3 lines as learned
Verify exact counts match before/after migration
